CVE-2017-0144.title: EternalBlue SMB Remote Code Execution
CVE-2017-0144.description: Remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft Server Message Block 1.0 (SMBv1) protocol.

CVE-2021-44228.title: Log4Shell JNDI Injection RCE

CVE-2014-6271.title: Shellshock Bash Remote Code Execution
CVE-2014-6271.description: Arbitrary command execution via crafted environment variables containing trailing function definitions.

CVE-2011-2523.title: vsftpd 2.3.4 Backdoor Command Execution

CVE-2007-2447.title: Samba MS-RPC Remote Command Execution (usermap script)
CVE-2007-2447.description: Remote command execution vulnerability in Samba allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands via MS-RPC username.

CVE-2012-1823.title: PHP CGI Argument Injection RCE
